decisions.title: Frozen reference, not moving main
decisions.value: ZingerLittleBee/Heeler 17e890481ae5a80e142395ab17974cee8655c6a4, including its current-main herdr-core scope. Do not substitute v0.1.17. Public screenshots are original bytes; their dates and logical iOS point sizes are not established.

decisions.title: Composition, density and behavior
decisions.value: Reproduce reference composition, density, controls and behavior, not a Material redesign. Preserve Goatr name/identity; Android owns keyboard, permissions, notifications/widgets and window handling. SVG text/fonts are schematic, not final pixel-perfect typography.

decisions.title: Licensed static Material Icons, not a Material redesign
decisions.value: Wireframe controls use filled Material Icons as inline SVG paths, reusing local 24×24 VectorDrawable artwork plus nine needed icons from google/material-design-icons 49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4. Preserve composition, density, labels, status circles, provider initials, terminal Unicode and keyboard legends. Exact pinned sources and Apache-2.0 attribution are in vendor/material-icons-NOTICE.txt. No icon font, sprite, framework, external asset dependency or production implementation is introduced. Design revision 3 renews review without changing review-store behavior.

decisions.title: Kotlin native Android Views
decisions.value: Use platform text/input/list facilities with custom layout/drawing where necessary. No Compose application framework and no wholesale Telegram application framework import.

decisions.title: API33+ adaptive Android
decisions.value: Minimum Android 13/API33, phones/tablets/foldables, live resizing, hardware keyboard and pointer. Mi 9T/API30 is not an acceptance target. Chosen design geometries are phone 412×915, tablet 1280×800, cover 360×800 and book 840×900; they are not measured iOS layouts or tested devices.

decisions.title: Linux, both native backends
decisions.value: Herdr TUI and herdr-core are required where supported by the reference. Official stock upgrades are allowed; private runtime patches are not. No global installation or running-service replacement is authorized by this gate. macOS/Windows are excluded.

decisions.title: Companion + iroh + n0 public relays
decisions.value: Users install a companion and pair. Direct connectivity is preferred with end-to-end encrypted relay fallback. No SSH/VPN enrollment or hosted private relay. Public rate limits, no SLA and latest-stable support limits are accepted, not production qualification. Never embed managed-service project secrets. SSH enrollment, jump-host and overlay controls are disclosed implementation differences, not dead controls.

decisions.title: Genuine pairing trust ceremony
decisions.value: Keep scan/paste → identity/trust preview → explicit Confirm using iroh identities rather than SSH enrollment. Expiry, mismatch and revocation fail closed. The studio has no genuine token or scannable QR; sample content says DEMO — NOT A PAIRING CODE.

decisions.title: Interactive terminals and actual Close
decisions.value: Real interactive Agent terminals, resize and takeover where native, with explicit confirmed Close/worktree removal. Disclose native pane/tab/workspace cascades and desktop effects, including final-pane consequences. Historical read-only/no-Close restrictions are superseded.

decisions.title: ntfy + UnifiedPush + end-to-end encryption
decisions.value: Use managed ntfy and a distributor app, with payload encryption. Authenticated-only/HMAC-only delivery is insufficient. No Goatr FCM sender service and no APNs relay reuse. Android system surfaces adapt outcomes rather than claiming Dynamic Island or portable lock-screen widgets.

decisions.title: Fresh pairing, clean protocol/data cutover
decisions.value: Fresh pairing is acceptable; remove obsolete production code and callers at the later cutover, not in this gate. Preserve existing source, installation data and caches until explicit replacement. Do not build compatibility/migration layers. docs/ was intentionally empty/deleted and stays deleted.

decisions.title: Qualify existing implementations and actual licenses
decisions.value: No full client is a drop-in base. Qualify useful ownership, IME, framing and recovery before reuse. Comply with actual revision/file notices, not assumed relicensing. Imported assets here are Heeler Apache-2.0 images, Google Material Icons Apache-2.0 static path artwork and exact Pixelmatch ISC source; donor application code is not imported.

decisions.title: Only public static reference evidence
decisions.value: No observed iOS execution is available. Owned Android emulators may suffice later but do not establish physical-phone performance, battery or background behavior. This studio does not run provider sessions, transport, notification or native runtime scenarios. Source comments reporting upstream checks are upstream reports, not Goatr evidence.

decisions.title: Bounded later provider calls only
decisions.value: Later acceptance may use existing configured accounts for small bounded prompts. No new signup/subscription, credential collection or provider call occurs in this studio gate. Missing later provider credentials remain named live-qualification blockers, never fixture-passed.

decisions.title: Studio review before production rewrite
decisions.value: User reviews this complete localhost studio first. Then implement genuine pairing → live Console → real terminal input/reconnect as the first working APK checkpoint. Matched captures are reviewed at checkpoints before UI expands; silence is not approval.

decisions.title: One owned runtime / connection / store
decisions.value: Preserve useful GoatrRuntime ownership and StateFlow behavior: Views observe one application-owned runtime, connection and store, never create a second endpoint/store. Requalify SecretStore, genuine pairing, native IME, strict bounded framing and no-replay/recovery. Remove Compose-specific state with every caller, not only its Gradle plugin.

decisions.title: Rust companion owns local Host operations
decisions.value: On Linux the Rust companion performs Unix-socket, PTY, filesystem, bounded process-evidence and Git operations the reference performs through SSH. No arbitrary remote-shell endpoint or new SSH/VPN setup is needed. Keep native TUI/core capability distinctions.

decisions.title: TUI: subscribe before snapshot + real PTY attach
decisions.value: Use session.snapshot and events.subscribe, subscribing before the initial snapshot, with actual native launch/control/Close methods. Local PTY runs official herdr agent attach <pane-id> [--takeover] or herdr terminal attach <terminal-id> [--takeover]. Retain attach bootstrap-query handling and truthful uncertain input.

decisions.title: Core: framed JSON-RPC and actual capabilities
decisions.value: Handshake hello {generation:1, framed:true}; require framed/attach/events/status capabilities and respect framed channels/credit. Use terminal.attach, terminal.run, terminal.interrupt and terminal.kill. Never invent core workspace.*, tab.*, account or preset APIs. Read herdr-app organization/labels; use only supported desktop rename controls. Passive reconnect must not autostart core.

decisions.title: Provider transcripts, not guessed conversations
decisions.value: Follow process/session identity and each provider native transcript. TUI has Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OMP, Grok Build, OpenCode; Linux core has the first five only. OpenCode core Chat is reference_unavailable at this pin. Host Accounts are JSON, Launch Presets device-local, Templates native core.

decisions.title: Exact Ghostty native engine / Zig boundary
decisions.value: Ghostty 82938b633ba646db38591d969c3c526332bd7e65 under libghostty-spm 7e45d27160f9b34aca9ca5c9820e9207482f9f04, Zig 0.16.0. Android build of this exact pin is UNVERIFIED. Use a small JNI/Zig adapter and custom Android View, not UIKit/Metal or old grid→VT. Include styles, key encoders, IME, scrollback, native selection, links and Kitty images. Virtual placements and animation require native Zig graphics_unicode.zig placement iteration and ImageStorage.animationTick, not a Kotlin reimplementation. Reference engine has no Sixel.

decisions.title: No client imports masquerading as parity
decisions.value: Bellterm custom TerminalView.kt is an Apache-2.0 View/IME/gesture donor, but its grid→VT/no-inline-image backend is not chosen. Older kruttan/Heeler Android fork is AGPL at its revision and provides JNI/graphics references but loses style/cursor/image layers and needs IME/UTF-8 corrections. Flutter herdr-mobile is workflow research with documented read-only terminal/provider limits, not the chosen stack. Telegram is a GPL application, not a supported standalone UI SDK; TDLib is not its UI toolkit.

decisions.title: Encryption replaces current HMAC-only payload
decisions.value: Port reference per-host/device privacy and seen/Done semantics, not its APNs service. Managed ntfy + UnifiedPush distributor must carry encrypted notification content; Android owns ongoing status, channels, permissions and widget surfaces.

decisions.title: Official runtime versions are research, not qualification
decisions.value: Herdr TUI v0.9.5 2ecf19a92fc3a7fff75b6ce3655ef04f4625ec01; core Linux reference baseline v0.1.13 88fe4e752debdc6ff6689eaa153d7f95819835a4; later core v0.1.18 3965a46caae095a3ead01de237fa13955e52b8c6 recorded for other-platform checks. The next handoff must capability-qualify and freeze an official Linux pair. No version is installed or claimed compatible here.

decisions.title: Source fixtures establish intent, not execution
decisions.value: Public screenshots, DemoScreenshotMode, ChatFixtures and plugin/test-vectors establish intended deterministic states. They are not observed iOS execution or live-provider pass results. Fixture capture, emulator capture and physical capture are distinct badges; wireframes are never genuine runtime captures.

decisions.title: Actual Android interaction and performance
decisions.value: UI Automator drives actual app/system UI; Macrobenchmark and Perfetto measure release-like scrolling, keyboard transitions, Agent switching and terminal output on a recorded environment. Emulator results remain emulator results; no physical battery/background claim follows.

decisions.title: Matched approved Android goldens only
decisions.value: Same-state, same-size Android captures become regression goldens after user design approval. Cross-platform images diagnose geometry/typography/control differences; no arbitrary whole-image percentage declares parity. Crops are deliberate, coordinates visible, no silent resizing.

decisions.title: Acceptance requires identity-bound actual effects
decisions.value: Verify intended Host pairing, input reaching intended terminal once, reconnect without repeats, no queued stale-target action, Blocked choice only for still-current prompt, Close only within displayed native scope and background notification opening the correct identity-bound target.

decisions.title: Graphics / input acceptance matrix
decisions.value: Check fragmented VT, Unicode/wide cells, complete styles/cursors, key press/repeat/release, CJK composition, bracketed paste, mouse/alternate-screen scrolling and Kitty layers/placeholders/animation. A native-library load or cell dump alone does not pass.

decisions.title: Review staleness is a design boundary
decisions.value: Each screen/variant has independent unreviewed, accepted or changes_requested notes. Successive designRevision changes and partial renewal retain every unrenewed variant's note, previous state and original review revision, while invalidating previous acceptance and showing Review needs renewal. Export does not pass application features. Increment designRevision whenever geometry, variants, behavior annotations or associated references change.

research.title: Chosen Heeler pin
research.finding: Current-main source scope includes core, Accounts and Launch Presets, not just v0.1.17 marketing screenshots. All 19 curated public screenshot files have original PNG bytes, measured header dimensions and SHA-256 in the asset catalog.
research.qualification: Pinned source and images, Apache-2.0 LICENSE inspected; no image-specific license/NOTICE exists in docs/images or ancestors beyond the root license. Raster screenshot content is reference intent, not observed runtime parity.

research.title: Core native capability boundaries
research.finding: Linux core Chat qualification list is Claude/Codex/Grok/Pi/OMP; OpenCode stays disabled after the 1.19.5 recheck despite a later-release success. Rename, ownership and helper requirements differ from TUI.
research.qualification: Static source research only; no Goatr runtime qualification or imported implementation code.

research.title: Official TUI version anchor
research.finding: Herdr TUI v0.9.5 is the recorded official research anchor. Qualify native attach, subscription, launch/control and Close at the next handoff.

research.title: Official core Linux baseline
research.finding: Core v0.1.13 is the reference-recorded Linux baseline; direct socket connection must avoid CLI connect/status autostart paths.
research.qualification: Source/ADR research, not this studio runtime qualification.

research.title: Later official core anchor

research.qualification: Version anchor only; no installation, service replacement or compatible-pair claim.

research.title: Engine dependency identity
research.finding: Ghostty.ref contains 82938b633ba646db38591d969c3c526332bd7e65. Zig 0.16.0 is required by the approved architecture; Android build at this exact pin is unverified.

research.title: Kitty virtual placement native access
research.finding: placementIterator and virtual-placement cells carry image/placement IDs and cell geometry; adapter must retain these beyond the incomplete public C surface.
research.qualification: Static source research only; no Goatr runtime qualification or imported implementation code.

research.title: Kitty animation native storage
research.finding: ImageStorage owns placements/images, mutation generations and animationTick; use native animation access, not a Kotlin approximation.
research.qualification: Static source research only; no Goatr runtime qualification or imported implementation code.

research.title: Bellterm native View donor
research.finding: Custom View uses Canvas, BaseInputConnection, OverScroller, gestures, selection and UTF-8 text input. Useful donor boundaries; grid→VT and absent inline-image path are not chosen terminal architecture.
research.qualification: Apache-2.0 LICENSE and TerminalView inspected; no donor code imported, no Android run performed.

research.title: Older native Android Heeler fork
research.finding: Android 0.1.0 source is older/incomplete relative to chosen pin. JNI/graphics plumbing is research only; style/cursor/image layers and IME/UTF-8 need qualification/corrections.
research.qualification: AGPL-3.0 LICENSE inspected at this revision. Current upstream Apache-2.0 does not relicense this older fork; no source imported.

research.title: Flutter herdr-mobile workflow reference
research.finding: README explicitly describes read-only text terminal, no cursor/mouse, at most 1000 rows and no API resize. Provider claims distinguish OMP, Claude, Codex approvals and incomplete Pi verification.
research.qualification: Public README read; moving main is a research citation only, not the frozen visual target or imported code. README identifies GPL-3.0-only; no workflow/runtime result was independently exercised.

research.title: Telegram custom Views are application internals
research.finding: Telegram is a GPL Android application with custom Views/Canvas, not a supported UI SDK; TDLib is messaging infrastructure, not its visual toolkit.
research.qualification: Approved-plan static research conclusion. No Telegram source/assets are imported; wholesale framework reuse is explicitly not selected.

research.title: n0 public relays
research.finding: Public relays need no key, encrypt traffic end-to-end, but expose connection metadata. Development/hobby support only, no SLA, rate limits, no version locking and latest-stable official support.
research.qualification: Public documentation read; selected support risks are accepted, not a production reliability qualification.

research.title: Project-wide secret restriction
research.finding: Managed-service API key signs endpoint-bound capabilities but remains a project-wide root secret; per-endpoint issuance flow is not implemented. Never ship it in consumer devices.
research.qualification: Public documentation read. This design retains public relays; no managed service signup or secret collection.

research.title: Nabto alternative
research.finding: Investigated managed device connectivity; not chosen because the settled companion/iroh flow retains existing transport without a new service dependency.
research.qualification: Approved-plan alternative research; not installed or qualified and no account created.

research.title: WebRTC alternative
research.finding: Peer connectivity still needs signaling and sometimes relay/TURN. Not selected over existing iroh.
research.qualification: Approved-plan alternative research, not a new signaling/server implementation task.

research.title: Cloudflare TURN alternative
research.finding: TURN credentials need server-side issuance and lifecycle; not a reason to embed a long-lived service secret in a mobile app.
research.qualification: Approved-plan alternative research; no service built, credential generated or signup performed.

research.title: Exact local Pixelmatch 8.0.0

research.qualification: Exact pinned implementation and ISC notice inspected/downloaded. Comparison is diagnostic, not a universal parity threshold.
